comment: Solo-Vibing v0.2 hook wiring. See docs/specs/0001-v0.2-cascade-integration/ for binding design docs. Edit via the cascade's update-linear / wrap surface, not by hand. $schema field intentionally omitted pending canonical URL publication by Anthropic (Child C apply-time queue item #10; v0.2.x adds the field once the URL is confirmed).

UserPromptSubmit.comment: Pre-flight chain-integrity check for cascade slash-commands. Script narrows to /review|/plan|/update-linear|/build|/wrap|/verify|/retro internally; no matcher field is supported on UserPromptSubmit (per D2.2 §Hook events table).

PreToolUse.comment: Pyramid-tampering guard for spec-file writes. Script narrows by file_path to docs/specs/*/spec.md.

Cascade-control write denylist guard per spec AC-21 / D4.1 §D4.1.7. Reads patterns from .claude/agents/build-write-denylist.txt; halts on match with §cascade-control-write-blocked. ENFORCES ONLY in build-agent context (env SOLO_BUILD_AGENT=1, set by Ralph's run.sh) — founder-session orchestration stages write cascade-control files unimpeded. The Bash arm closes the shell-redirection bypass (the build agent runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions); the hook inspects Bash write-targets only in build-agent context and soft-passes instantly otherwise.

PostToolUse.comment: Reserved for v0.1 mirror-sha predicate carry-forward (Linear-write tools). v0.2 does not add new PostToolUse hooks; the carry-forward predicate is wired by the v0.1 codebase. This empty array is the placeholder that test_settings_json_wires_all_events asserts.

SubagentStop.comment: The cascade's single agent-judgment-shaped hook per D3.4 §What is a gate. Realized as command-type Python (per surfaced item in four-hat-objection-coverage-hook.md). Output: top-level-fields-only Stop/SubagentStop quirk per D2.2.

SessionStart.comment: Cross-session state restoration. Source-matched dispatch inside the script (startup vs resume vs compact vs clear branches).

PreCompact.comment: Three-band threshold + safe-boundary check per D2.2 §Compact mechanics. Handles both trigger=manual and trigger=auto (no matcher needed; script reads trigger from payload).

Stop.comment: The cascade's single Stop-hook orchestrator per D2.2 §Research-step resolution #3. Dispatches kill_in_progress, manual_halt, and per-skill completion predicates. Stop has no matchers (D2.2 §Hook events table).

SessionEnd.comment: Per-session telemetry sink. Async fire-and-forget per D2.2 §Critical caveats #4. Appends one JSONL line per session to .cascade/telemetry/sessions.jsonl.
